fields.name: Pettenderly
fields.description: Pettenderly is an AI pet portrait studio for cat and dog owners. Upload one to five clear photos of the same pet, choose a style, and create a digital portrait to download. Available looks include watercolor, royal portraits, studio scenes and sunny window-seat settings. You & your pet and Photo cleanup offer additional beta tools; generated faces, markings and details can vary. Pettenderly uses paid credits: one credit per successful image, with no credit charged for failed generations. The product delivers digital images, without physical printing or shipping.
fields.tags: AI pet portraits, cats, dogs, image generation
